Status SourceOnlyUnverified; no import/AST/test/build/compiler/lint/device/GPU/process/Git/cleanup
executed by implementer. New private fixture candidate, old worktree/histogram packet/report untouched.
Expected consumer base: WN0691bcdf plus unchanged histogram-source-v1 candidate AFTER files. Copied
before/after those3histogram source files are byte-identical dependencies, not another production edit.
CMake base is WN0691; new one-context patch changes ONLY CMake CPU target/registers and adds2test files.

Meaningful actual path:
- Calls production expert_pool_dispatch_multi from unchanged candidate expert_source.cpp. Actual
  ExpertPool(2workers,pin=false,hostworks=true) executes run_split_multi_native GU/intermediateQuant/
  Down kernels. No replacement dispatch/grouping/count algorithm or dummy CPU output implementation.
- Uses production native_fmt/native_expert metadata loader and actual H2560/FF640/MAXT8 guards,
 2layers8experts, valid deterministic IQ3_S GU/IQ4_NL Down packed blocks. Same syntactic block generator
  pattern as existing iq_avx2_parity: randomized bits/full blocks plus small finiteFP16 scale. Both
  actuallayer fmt/shape/offset extent guards; no shard/model/tokenizer/GPU read or initialization.
- CPU Source blob returns stable vector slices under exactlayer/expert bounds. Input/output vectors
  remain owned through synchronous native pool GU/quant/Down completion; pool destructor joins workers
  before source blobs free. No buffer belongs to GPU, no host-USM/device allocation/graph/queue involved.
- Reference arrays are actual unbound-dispatch/pool results, not an arithmetic oracle. Bound observer
  arrays compare every float bit-for-bit and finite/complete sentinel checks. In ON mode reference still
  runs under frozenopt-in1 but without binding; observer pointerNULL, actual math same productioncall.
  This proves binding neutrality within one process, not a different binary/model correctness result.
  Separate --off CTest process sets opt-in0 before firstuse and requires no histogram at all. No flag
  mutation after frozen flag firstuse. Source does not claim cross-process raw arrays compared; Main
  can add owned serialization/fingerprint comparison if independent-process OFF/ON proof needed.

Literal expected test matrices (same actual routing IDs passed to dispatcher):
- T1,k2 IDs0/1 ->2NT1jobs/2rows per layer.
- T8,k1 repeatedexpert0 ->1NT8job/8rows per layer.
- T8,k2 expert0eachrow + secondIDs1,2,2,3,3,3,4,4 ->5jobs/16rows perlayer,
  NT1=1,NT2=2,NT3=1,NT8=1. Expectations literals, not generated with duplicated grouping/count code.
- Request1 two read_windows-equivalent bindings (T1k2 +T8k1) ->3jobs/10rows eachlayer, NT1=2/NT8=1.
- Request2 freshscope mixed case ->onlyits5jobs16rows; no earlier cumulative counter pollution.
- finish twice+destructor emits once; exactlyheader+2layer lines, correctzero-based layer/actualtypeIDs,
  <=32KiB/request, no per-job log. Current fixture testsNT1/2/3/8, not everyNT4..7 or overflow boundary.
- Errorcase actual MAXT guard rejectsn_tok9 after validT1k2 dispatch; scopeRAIIdestructor emits
  error_or_early_exit partialdata. R255 consumer accepts full ONLY statusprompt_complete/invalid0/
  overflow0 (and eligible1); partial with otherwisevalid counters explicitly rejected. Actual guard
  failure happened before another poolcall, earlier completed outputs/counts preserved.

CPU-only linker design/known unverified gate:
- Linux/native-expert/STRATA_BUILD_TESTS target links ONLY strata_kernels_cpu (GGML CPU/base+Threads),
  not strata_engine/strata_core/strata_kernels/strata_sycl, CUDA/HIP/SYCL/UR/L0 libraries. Compile the
  unchangedexpert_source.cpp specificallyinfixture with function/data sections; GNU/LLD gc-sections
  discards unreferenced engine/GPU functions/vtables, no production target option changed.
- Retained dispatcher references RemoteExperts::begin/finish and ExpertCache::slot_of even though
  d.plan=NULL/remote_count0/cacheNULL/host_resNULL/pcie_num0. Three fixture-only abort traps satisfy
  those unreachable references. They do NOT returnfakeCPU/GPU/cache data, do NOT replace actual
  dispatcher/pool/observer code, and abort beforeGPU actions if eligibility violated. Explicit
  CPU-only eligibility assertedbeforeevery actual call. Allzero plan means CPU misses only; cache/
  PCIe/remote attribution intentionally not tested by thisCPU fixture.
- Actual link/DT_NEEDED are UNVERIFIED. Main must inspect linkmap and dynamic dependencies BEFORE
  test: no SYCL/UR/L0/CUDA/HIP driver/runtime load; no engine/core target fallback permitted. If section
  stripping leaves other unresolved engine symbols, preserve failure and review another narrowly
  unreachable abort trap/extraction; do NOT link GPU runtime to makeCPU fixturepass. No runtime/driver
  symbol calls allowed. CPU CTest label alone does not establish CPU-only execution.
- C++20/Linux/POSIX dup/dup2/tmpfile/mkdtemp assumed; CMake registersLinux only, skip77 withoutAVX2,
  TIMEOUT120/RUN_SERIAL. Main owns finite parent/session CPU/RSS/files/exclusivemeasurement lock.
  CTest timeout is not substituted for Main qualifiedanchored owner/normalclosure. No subprocess,
  retry/reset/GPU sweep/model/benchmark launched by fixture itself.

Artifacts/lifetime:
- Captures histogram stderr into bounded temporaryFILE, restores descriptor on normal/failure unwinding.
  CPU fixture process generates tiny native_experts.txt in uniqueowned/tmpdirectory, retained and path
  printedforMain review/retention. No explicit file deletion/cleanup. Blocks/floatarrays RAM-only, bounded
  fmt.bytes<=16MiB and16experts -><=256MiB, actual selectedlayoutabout36MiB. Capture<=32KiB eachcase.
- No performance/roofline/fullmodelparity/read_windows GPU graph integration claim. Countsdispatch
  attempts and frequencyweights only. Error/partialcounts nevercompleteperR255. Syntheticweights and
 2layergeometry are meaningfulCPUactualpath controls, not realpack/shard/48layermodel proof.
- Stdmutex/sharedownership remainhostCPUobserver; no productionmath/order/routing/defaultpolicy change
  in thispacket. GPU branchfailtraps linkedonlythisCPUtest, neverproduction binary.

Main test plan: MAIN_TEST_PLAN.txt; manifest allsourceprovenance/beforeafterSHA. Sourcecandidate not
applied; Main alone createsnewworktree, appliesexistinghistogram thenfixturepatch, builds/lints/host
sanitizers/linkaudits/CPU tests underlock and recordsactualresults. Existing measuredresults preserved.
